description: Indirect validator results tested through `!ok` / `ok === false` / `!err`: the leading negation (or false sentinel) moves the validated edge, so early returns are safe and sinks on the failure branch fire.

expected.notes: `!ok` and `ok === false` return before the sink on validation failure
sink inside `if (!ok)` runs exactly when validation failed
`if (!err) return` leaves the error case to reach the sink
